purpose: check whether a long-context detector removes the need for the windowed cascade in Phase 4

load_attempt_1.system_state: swap exhausted, ~1.85GB free, other apps (PyCharm, Firefox, 2 other Claude sessions) running
load_attempt_1.conclusion: not reproducible on retry -- likely transient memory pressure, not a fixed disqualifier

long_context_test.setup: identical attack sentence embedded in 1218 tokens of benign filler (well under the 8192 cap)
long_context_test.expected: > 0.9 if the model truly uses its full context to find the signal
long_context_test.result: FAIL -- classic needle-in-haystack failure. Architecture accepts long input; this fine-tune was not trained to find sparse signal within it.

decision: Long-context shortcut REJECTED. Proceed with the 3-tier windowed cascade against deberta-v3-base-prompt-injection-v2 as designed in Phase 4. A large max_position_embeddings value does not imply the fine-tune can use that context for sparse-signal detection -- must be verified empirically, not assumed from config.
